name: list-suppressions
description:
**Purpose:** List email addresses on the suppression list. Suppressed addresses never receive emails from the account. Optionally filter by origin: "bounce" (added automatically after a hard bounce), "complaint" (added automatically after a spam complaint), or "manual" (added via the API or dashboard).

**NOT for:** Checking a single address (use get-suppression). Not for listing contacts (use list-contacts).

**Returns:** For each suppression: email, id, origin, source_id (when present), created_at. Use pagination (limit, after/before) for large lists.

**When to use:** User says "show my suppression list", "who is suppressed?", or "why isn't this person receiving emails?" combined with a broad look at suppressed addresses.

after.description: Suppression ID after which to retrieve more (for forward pagination). Cannot be used with "before".

before.description: Suppression ID before which to retrieve more (for backward pagination). Cannot be used with "after".

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

limit.description: Number of suppressions to retrieve. Default: 20, Max: 100, Min: 1

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

origin.description: Only return suppressions with this origin: "bounce", "complaint", or "manual".
